items.title: Figma Weave image and video models now reachable from AI agents via the Figma MCP
items.excerpt: Figma release notes (Oct 26): video and image models from Figma Weave are now available to your AI agent through the Figma MCP server; generations draw on Weave credits.

items.title: Figma adds version history for generative plugins and shaders
items.excerpt: Editing a Figma generative plugin or shader now creates a new version you can revisit or restore; each version gets an agent-written description and the list marks which one is published.

items.title: Make your Figma design system agent-ready
items.excerpt: Figma walks through structuring libraries, variables and component docs so the Figma agent produces designs that look and feel like your product.

items.title: Config India 2026: When everyone can make anything, how far can we take it? (teamLab's Daisuke Sakai)
items.excerpt: teamLab co-founder Daisuke Sakai asks what creative work means when anyone can generate images, build software and ship products faster than ever.

items.title: GitHub open-sources Replica, an AI prototyping tool built by GitHub Design
items.excerpt: GitHub is open-sourcing Replica, an AI-powered prototyping tool from GitHub Design that turns product ideas into interactive prototypes built with your own design system.

items.title: Generate and edit images directly in GitHub Copilot
items.excerpt: GitHub Copilot can now generate and edit images from natural-language requests; the selected reasoning model calls a dedicated image-generation tool.

items.title: Qt Group launches Clate, an AI-native design tool for embedded interfaces
items.excerpt: Qt Group unveiled Clate, an AI-powered design environment for embedded UIs that combines no-code building, natural-language prompts and production-ready QML output.

items.title: Foundry releases Nuke 18.0 in open beta with a Griptape node for AI image and video workflows
items.excerpt: Nuke 18.0's new Griptape node connects the compositor to Foundry's AI orchestration platform, letting artists run generative image and video workflows - such as generating a dust element - inside the node graph.

items.title: NVIDIA RTX Spark powers neural rendering and AI characters in games
items.excerpt: NVIDIA details neural rendering and on-device AI character tooling for its RTX Spark Windows platform, pairing a Blackwell RTX GPU with a Grace CPU in slim laptops and compact desktops.

items.title: RTX Spark Windows laptops gain new models, agent tools and creator apps
items.excerpt: RTX Spark laptops from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI ship with new local AI models and agent tools aimed at developers and creators.

items.title: Runway launches App Studio: describe a creative tool and it builds a custom app
items.excerpt: Runway App Studio builds custom creative apps from a plain-language description, generating images, video and audio with your Brand Kits and Workflows; apps can be shared with a team or published by link.

items.title: Google DeepMind's Genie 4 generates more realistic interactive worlds
items.excerpt: Google DeepMind announced Genie 4, a world model for real-time interactive simulation that turns prompts into explorable, more realistic AI-generated worlds.

items.title: 8 examples of Gemini 4 Argon in action, from deep research to interactive design
items.excerpt: Google shows eight uses of Gemini 4 Argon, its most capable model, including interactive design work.

items.title: Apple Creator Studio adds new AI features and more creative tools
items.excerpt: Apple updated Creator Studio, its bundle of pro creative apps, with new AI features for video editing, music and image design, plus MotionVFX tools for Final Cut Pro.

items.title: These people are cutting the clutter and redesigning their smart TVs with AI
items.excerpt: Tinkerers are pasting prompts into AI coding agents to replace ad-cluttered smart-TV home screens with custom launchers - from liturgical-calendar dashboards to app icons styled as books on a shelf.

items.title: 3 design principles in the AI age
items.excerpt: A design leader argues iteration, feedback and craft still define good design, and that AI feedback should be one input among diverse human perspectives, not the only one.

items.title: The time AI saves designers usually disappears. Here's how to keep it.
items.excerpt: What a survey of 521 UX professionals found about where AI time savings go - and how designers can keep them.

items.title: The agent woke up before you did
items.excerpt: The last assumption of user-centered design just fell as four companies pushed proactive agents at once - what designing for agents that act before the user asks means.

items.title: Smaller teams want design leaders who make, again
items.excerpt: AI is shrinking design teams and raising the bar for each person's output, so leaders are expected to be player-coaches who still make the work.

items.title: Generate character variations instantly with AI Assistant in Frame.io
items.excerpt: Frame.io's AI Assistant uses Firefly to turn one character image into multiple angle variations and saves them straight into the project folder.

items.title: Vectorworks 2027 AI Visualizer adds Google's Nano Banana 2 and Nano Banana Pro
items.excerpt: Vectorworks 2027's AI Visualizer palette now offers Nano Banana 2 for fast concept iteration and Nano Banana Pro for presentation images, at 2K with 4K upscaling and up to 14 reference images per prompt.

items.title: Allplan Max delivers engineering AI across the Allplan portfolio
items.excerpt: Allplan Max is a purpose-built engineering AI that automates repetitive design work and offers expert guidance across Allplan's BIM tools.

items.title: Lovable ad passed off a designer's handmade website as AI work
items.excerpt: Designer Joe Taylor of 12 Studio says Lovable showed his hand-built Forge Automotive website in an Instagram ad as AI-generated work; Lovable pulled the ad.

items.title: Microsoft's MAI-Image-2.6 and MAI-Image-2.6-Flash hit general availability in Foundry
items.excerpt: Microsoft made MAI-Image-2.6 and its Flash variant generally available in Foundry, adding reference editing, Bing grounding, flexible image controls and cheaper generation.
